provenance.what: Rows of the node-graph caption clipping law: a title and a measured width budget -> the string a presentation draws.
provenance.law: A caption is the node's NAME clipped by the presentation's OWN text measure: the longest prefix that still fits `maxWidth` once `…` is appended, the whole string when it already fits, the bare `…` when not even one glyph plus the ellipsis fits, and nothing at all for empty text or a non-positive budget. Width is never answered by shrinking the font.
provenance.measure: Every row is measured with the synthetic advance `charWidth * <characters>` (the ellipsis counts as one character) so both implementations are driven by the SAME measure; in production each presentation passes its own — the wgpu glyph atlas, the browser canvas `measureText`.

rows.name: a-title-that-fits-is-drawn-whole
rows.why: The live generation3d title `extrude` at its own node width fits — one glyph was never a width verdict.

rows.name: a-title-wider-than-its-node-is-clipped-with-exactly-one-ellipsis
rows.why: The caption is clipped at the measured width, never shrunk to an unreadable font.

rows.name: a-budget-too-narrow-for-one-glyph-yields-the-bare-ellipsis
rows.why: There is always a visible sign that a caption was clipped.

rows.name: a-multi-byte-title-clips-on-character-boundaries
rows.why: German captions must not be cut mid-codepoint — the second UI language of this repo.

rows.name: surrounding-whitespace-is-trimmed-before-measuring
rows.why: A padded operator name must not spend its budget on blanks.

rows.name: an-empty-title-stays-empty
rows.why: A node with no name draws nothing rather than a lone ellipsis.

rows.name: a-non-positive-budget-draws-nothing
rows.why: A collapsed node has no room for a caption at all.

rows.name: a-title-exactly-at-the-budget-is-not-clipped
rows.why: The comparison is inclusive, so a caption that just fits is never ellipsized.
